title: LakeCTF Finals 23
description: The 9 qualified teams from LakeCTF Quals 23 as well as the winning team of Insomni'hack's CTF (student bracket) are invited to play the finals at EPFL.
prizes:
1st place: 1 Life sized psyduck plushie + 8 Led shoes
2nd place: 8 POC||GTFO books and 8 blinkenrocket kits
3rd place: 8 Amazon Gift cards and 8 Arch linux live CD-ROM

All players from the top three teams will also receive a challenge coin each.
